gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Funky and loose, Groovy nearly seals its c, while Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs opens up and stands tall. One squeezes shut, the other breathes, and they share the line happily.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Friendly from the first letter, Groovy has a funky looseness, with its lowercase spaced out and its c nearly closed. Noto Sans Arabic handles the quiet work: wide openings, tall small letters.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-armenian: A narrow slit nearly shuts the c in Groovy, whose loosely tracked lowercase and constant-width strokes feel funky and friendly. Noto Sans Armenian brings the opposite: wide, inviting round letters.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Loose and funky, Groovy nearly seals its c and spreads its lowercase out. Noto Sans Balinese keeps a breathing space in every curve, with short ascenders, so the two sit comfortably together.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Noto Sans Bamum opens every small letter wide and clean. Next to Groovy, with its nearly shut c, paragraphs set in it move along smoothly, the curves ending before they turn inward.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-bhaiksuki: Noto Sans Bhaiksuki reads clearly, its lowercase swollen and its apertures open. Groovy, bent as if from a single length of wire, supplies the funky headline energy while the body keeps things approachable.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Noto Sans Cherokee reads tall and approachable, with short stalks above. Groovy does funky best, closing its c to a slit, while the body does open, legible letters best.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Groovy nearly seals its c and loosens its lowercase, a funky, friendly sort of heading. Noto Sans Cuneiform opens its e instead, and that closed-versus-open tension is what holds the pair together.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret sits wide and high, with squat ascenders. Against Groovy's closed, constant-width letters, those open apertures are where the pairing wins, offering clear and approachable legibility.
gen-dafont-groovy-gf-noto-sans-glagoliti: Funky, loose and nearly sealed at the c, Groovy is all personality. Noto Sans Glagolitic counters with sturdy, open round letters, and that closed-against-open split is the pairing's best quality.
